name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
notes: Public Data API and RSS feeds are linked; the API docs were not read, so api_status is not recorded. The site lists no job postings.

review.note: API v1.0 is open without registration; v2.0 requires registration, so public-open is recorded for the open tier. Founded 1884 from About BLS. No statement of how jobs are ingested, as BLS is a statistics agency.
